thread:
aj (oncall): prod-eu GPU serving fleet showing 502s behind the external LB. Multiple nodes report failed health checks starting ~10:03 UTC. Autoscaler refusing to scale up because kube-probes are failing.
marie (netops): looking at VPC flow logs and NACL logs now. seeing a lot of DENY for ephemeral ports to external health check IPs. will post snippet.
marie (netops): ```
Apr 22 10:03:11 DENY tcp 10.0.12.45:52344 -> 3.120.45.67:443 (ephemeral)
Apr 22 10:03:12 DENY tcp 10.0.12.46:52345 -> 3.120.45.67:443 (ephemeral)
```
aj (oncall): that's the LB health check IP range (3.120.45.64/27). NACLs were supposed to allow ephemeral egress to those ranges.
sam (infra): did anyone change the network ACLs in prod-eu in the last 24h? terraform state shows a change in the network team PR yesterday.
marie (netops): yep there's a terraform apply at 02:15 UTC by `terraform-runner` with message "tighten nacl rules - remove wide egress". I think the rule that allowed ephemeral ports (30000-32767) was removed and a default DENY applied.
tess (sre): that's why kube-probe traffic to the external LB got blocked. health checks hit nodePort range and were DENYed.
aj (oncall): can we add a temporary allow rule to NACL to confirm? If LB health checks pass after that, we revert the terraform change properly.
marie (netops): applying temporary rule now: `aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0a1b2c3d --rule-number 110 --protocol tcp --port-range From=30000,To=32767 --egress --rule-action allow`
deploy-bot: deploy started: netops/allow-ephemeral-110 (plan: add rule 110)
marie (netops): rule applied.
aj (oncall): rechecking LB health status...
sam (infra): kube-probes are green, LB target group shows healthy count increasing. autoscaler now registering more pods; GPU capacity is scaling.
aj (oncall): 502s stopped ~2m after the rule add. Confirmed with traces: the denied packets stop after 10:07 UTC.
marie (netops): I'll open a revert PR to undo the over-restrictive change and instead add a scoped ephemeral egress allow for the LB ranges. Also adding a test in the TF pipeline to catch removal of nodePort/ephemeral rules.
tess (sre): action items: 1) revert the blanket NACL removal (marie), 2) add automated check for healthcheck egress (sam), 3) postmortem note and alert for NACL changes (aj). I'll create the incident and assign.
aj (oncall): root cause summary for postmortem: terraform change removed an essential ephemeral egress allowance in the prod-eu NACL which blocked LB health checks to nodePort ranges; caused temporary 502s and prevented autoscaler from adding GPU-serving pods. Will track remediation and a runbook for reverting NACL misconfigs.
marie (netops): FYI the TF change was trying to reduce broad egress but accidentally removed a rule that was keeping nodePort ephemeral traffic allowed. We'll scope it by source CIDR and keep port range.
sam (infra): also noting cost impact: a brief spike in error-retries caused additional inference retries on client side; estimate ~2000 extra token equivalents for the window. low $$ but fragile.
aj (oncall): thanks all. closing thread after postmortem doc is up. :white_check_mark:
